text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is in effect, so keep tonight’s waterfront plans close to shore. Sunset came in clear, but clouds will build as a cold front approaches, with a 40% chance of showers after 11pm. South winds will run 12 to 16 mph in town and 15 to 25 knots on the lake, where waves build to 3 to 5 feet. It stays mild for October, with a low around 49.

Tomorrow starts with a brief round of showers possible before 11am, then skies turn partly sunny as the front moves through. The high only reaches about 57, with gusty west winds, and the lake remains rough early before settling some. I’d keep tonight’s outing land-based and have a rain jacket ready for the Monday morning commute.

week.blurb: A mild, mostly cloudy Sunday reaches 65, with showers possible after 11 tonight.
Partly sunny Monday tops out near 57, with a few showers possible before late morning.
Bright and breezy Tuesday brings a high near 55 under sunny skies.
Partly sunny Wednesday reaches 61, with a few showers possible after dark.
A mild 64 Thursday brings partly sunny skies, with showers possible from morning into the evening.
Mostly sunny Friday reaches 60, with a few showers possible late afternoon and again overnight.
Mostly sunny Saturday brings a seasonable high near 57, with a cooler, partly cloudy night.
